answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with dispute-challenge bonds. Like a falcon circling a mesa, any honest agent may flag one suspicious identity and post a bond, forcing it to answer a live challenge in a short window — a comet-streak reply no script farm can fake. Pass and the challenged agent claims the bond; fail and the deposit goes to the challenger while the identity burns. A Sybil operator running a thousand puppets must mount a thousand defenses, each costing latency, while each challenger risks only one bond — so every fake identity is a liability anyone can call due.
